senses.gloss: m. (√רס; v. רְסַס; as to modification of meaning cmp. Lat. virus) prop. drop, fluid. esp. poison.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 3:1:4">Y. Ter. III, beg. 42ᵃ</cite> the serpent <he>הטיל בו א׳</he> threw a drop (of poison) into it.
Sabb. 62ᵇ (play on t’akkasnah, Is. III, 16) כארס בכעוס (read כא׳ עכיס; v. Var. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) like the serpent’s poison; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:3:7">Y. Maasr. V, end, 52ᵃ</cite> an onion <he>שאין לו אירם</he> (read <he>אירס</he>) which has no penetrating moisture.—Pl. <he>אֵרְסִין</he>, <he>אֵירְסִין</he>. Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵉᵈ. Cmp. <cite ref="T00654"><he>רִיס</he></cite>.
